title: Create: Scoria Anti-trypophobia Replacement
description: to make that damn rock less holey for those of us who really hate holey rocks (trypophobia filter!!!!!!!). accessibility ftw.
body:
for those of us who hate holes (trypophobia). i know real scoria rock does look holey but i would rather not see it. thanks.

the texture has been smoothed out a bit, but still (hopefully) recognizable against its smoothed counterparts et al (soul soil, etc). 

this also acts as a replacement for scorchia, a palette-swapped version of scoria.
